id.item.name.lich.head: Lich King's Trophy
id.item.lore.lich.chestplate_upgraded: This runic chestplate, cursed by Hiyl'dilan, saved the Lich King's life countless times, until today...
id.item.lore.lich.leggings_upgraded: War tribute retrieved from Wintergarde and gifted by his brother Goliath. These leggings, imbued with primal magic, have conquered many kingdoms.
id.item.lore.lich.boots_upgraded_alpha: Neither water nor snow could swallow the reign of the Lich King.
id.item.lore.lich.boots_upgraded: The ground freezes beneath the Lich King's footsteps.

id.dialogue.lichking.attack_1: May my wrath fall upon the weakest!
id.dialogue.lichking.attack_3: May the biting cold freeze your blood!
id.dialogue.lichking.attack_4: May the plague rot you to the bone!
id.dialogue.lichking.phase_3_b: ...Lend me your strength one last time!
id.dialogue.lichking.phase_4: I will take you down with me, miserable insect!
